name: Guyana
shortSummary: Guyana is home to a large Indo-Guyanese population (roughly 40% of the population), anchoring close ties, alongside growing Indian interest in Guyana's recent oil discoveries.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: One of the largest Indian-origin populations by share in the world underpins deep cultural ties.
